line: Half an open-source keyboard comes apart in one orbit, down to the chip, then closes with its real dimensions.
line_cn: 开源键盘的一半在一次环绕中逐层拆开，看到主控再合拢，标上真实尺寸。

camera.expresses: the whole, its order of assembly

camera.serves: a hidden component; how it works

camera.move: Slow push on one still part
camera.serves: a chip, a sensor, a seal

transitions: Transitions are camera moves through the object itself.
No cuts to black, no slide transitions, no split screens.
labels: Names: a clean sans at medium weight in the film's script (28–32 px; Noto Sans SC 500 in our demo). Specs and numbers: a monospaced face (15–22 px; JetBrains Mono) so digits line up and read as measurement. A neutral grotesque (Inter) for Latin running text.
Label structure is fixed: a two-digit index in the accent, the name, one spec line. Units always written (mm, MB, ×n for counts). A label carries at most one fact the voice does not say.
Dimension text sits on a small dark plate, follows the line's angle and is never upside down.

Subtitles: a centred strip at the bottom with a soft shadow and no box; if the film is bilingual, the film's language on top. Hold every cue ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s); every label stays fully in frame for CJK ÷ 4.5 + other ÷ 15 + 1.5 s.
motion: 24 fps on ones; everything is smooth and deterministic.
Separation: smooth start, fast middle, long settle (ease-in-out cubed); layers leave top first, 0.15–0.2 s apart; repeated parts (keys, screws) fan out in a wave ordered by distance from a corner.
Closing: bottom first, quicker (about 1 s per layer), the last layer lands with a real mechanical response (a key travels its stroke and returns; nothing bounces like rubber unless it is rubber).
While held apart, layers may float a millimetre or two with offset phases; during macro shots they hold perfectly still.

native_moves.name: The wave lift
native_moves.does: Repeated parts rise in a wave across the object.
native_moves.fits: battery cells; solar tiles; the drawers of a modular shelf.

native_moves.name: Inside the gap
native_moves.does: The camera enters the space between two lifted layers to see a hidden face.
native_moves.fits: the back of a logic board; the inside of a drone arm; the underside of a sensor module.

native_moves.name: The leader that lands on the part
native_moves.does: A macro label whose line ends on the component.
native_moves.fits: a pressure sensor in a shoe; a gasket in a waterproof case; a motor driver.

native_moves.name: Dimensions drawn on the thing
native_moves.does: After closing, the real outline gets dimension lines in perspective.
native_moves.fits: the thickness of a laptop lid; the footprint of a router; the bore of a valve.

native_moves.name: One real motion
native_moves.does: A part performs its true mechanical motion once (a press, a hinge, a latch).
native_moves.fits: a camera shutter; a buckle; a folding hinge.

native_moves.name: Lights on inside
native_moves.does: Emitters inside the product switch on while it is apart.
native_moves.fits: status LEDs; a backlit display; an indicator ring.

score.note: tuned mallets and glass, a round bass, a short synthetic kick
